conditional_contract_risks: road_mac_probe does not internally count or reject more than 24 accepted groups
road_mac_probe consumes first and last as caller-supplied protocol attributes and does not reject malformed sequences
the chain permits table loading whenever the MAC is idle, including a gap between reduction groups; the low-I/O shell must separate load and run modes
validation covers one four-position RUN per reset; repeated RUN without reset is not established by this review

signed_and_width_review.position_counter: 2-bit modulo-4 wrap is intentional and exact for four positions
signed_and_width_review.channel_counter: 2-bit increment is guarded by channel != 2 and therefore only performs 0->1 or 1->2
signed_and_width_review.rescale_product: signed32 multiplied by signed32 nonnegative fixed factor produces signed64
signed_and_width_review.round_output: the 16-bit result bit pattern is reinterpreted as signed before signed saturation comparisons
signed_and_width_review.cache_indices: write base is restricted to 0,3,6,9 and derived +1/+2 indices remain within 0..11
signed_and_width_review.multiple_driver_or_comb_loop: none found in the frozen four-source manual review

notes: each two-beat position spends 11 cycles from first to second accept and 10 cycles from last accept to chain terminal handshake
the MAC result becomes visible one edge before the chain samples its terminal handshake; this does not change the frozen MAC latency
each pre-rescale interval is 11 cycles: boundary handoff plus PREPARE, PRE_SEND and round wait
each SiLU interval is 7 cycles from pre-round endpoint to SiLU-output endpoint
each post-rescale interval is 10 cycles from SiLU-output endpoint to post-round endpoint
the twelve read responses are one cycle after their request and requests are spaced four cycles apart in the original testbench
